easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Gigantoplasm enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Gigantoplasm from the battlefield to your hand.
When Gigantoplasm leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Gigantoplasm from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.
